title: 冬の自然の切り絵イラスト
subject_en: Winter nature items, each a separate object, layered cut-paper craft style with flat colour shapes and soft paper edges, blues and whites with warm accents Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 雪の結晶、冬の木、ひいらぎ、こおりの花。切り絵ふうに描いた、冬の自然12点。
items: a large six-pointed snowflake in pale blue
a pine tree with snow on its branches
a holly sprig with red berries
a red camellia flower with snow on the leaves
a nandina branch with red berries
three hanging icicles from a small eave
a small snowman with a scarf and branch arms
a snowy mountain peak with a pale sun
a crescent moon with two stars
a small bird on a snowy branch
a snow cloud with falling flakes
